Tea Journey is a digital tea magazine that allows the discerning tea lover easy access to newly translated and well-researched tea content. Sourced from foreign-language publications in the tea lands, this mobile, multi-media publication inspires readers to discover and refine their taste in tea.

Tea Journey publishes three issues annually. These include the April (Origin) issue, the August (Tea Review) issue, and the November (Gifting) issue. All include a downloadable 150-page print-ready PDF that is also available as a bound printed version. During the weeks between issues, subscribers receive full-featured articles and multi-media content on the Tea Journey blog.

-Annual Subscription $24.99 (12 months access)
- Monthly Access $4.99 (1 month access)

Payment is charged to your iTunes Account on confirmation of purchase. Access is immediate. The subscription will automatically renew for all subscriptions except the “Take a Sip Sample” unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. The cost of renewal will match the initial subscription price. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during your active subscription period. 

Most information available in English is focused on marketing sachets and tins. Tea Journey shifts the conversation from tins to terroir and from packets to people with stories about exceptional artisans and extraordinary tea gardens.  A third of the content originates with respected Chinese-language publications like Cha Dao Life and Pu’erh Magazine as well as Korean, Japanese and Hindu tea titles.

Tea Journey is formatted for print, but out of respect for the world’s forests it is distributed as a digital publication. The mobile magazine includes sections with tasting notes to develop your tea expertise, interviews with tea growers and tea masters, and profiles of artisans in teacraft and teaware. There are profiles of collectors, scientists, antiquities scholars and tea blenders. Targeting established tea lovers, thirsty for a deeper connection to culture and origin, each issue helps readers discover and refine their taste in tea – helping them select, correctly prepare, and serve the finest teas from around the world.

Sections include Health & Wellness and Teaware & Antiquities, Tasting Notes and Tea Cuisine. Regular features include Tea Quest, tales of travel and adventure, the Puer Pages and a series on Tea & Tech that includes reports on modern tea brewers, tea apps and gadgets.

Three billion people drink tea daily both for its pleasant taste and the wakefulness it brings. Tea is proven to enhance the well-being of those who drink several cups a day. This is why consumption globally increased 60% between 1993 and 2010.  The greatest benefit accrues to those who drink several cups a day. Discovering a favorite tea increases the frequency of consumption which becomes a daily ritual and, in time, a healthy life-long habit.

Injection World is a free global monthly magazine for designers and manufacturers of injection molded plastic parts. Published by AMI Magazines, it covers developments in machinery and materials technology. It also includes global news and market analysis, together with special reports on automotive, medical, packaging and electrical applications.

Injection World is essential reading for anyone involved in the injection molding supply chain, including OEMs and brand owners, molders, moldmakers, product designers, and component specifiers. This app provides free access to past and current editions.
